name: CodeFaeries Save Later – Wishlist and Save for Later for WooCommerce
author: Long Watch Studio - Code Faeries

sections.description:
CodeFaeries Save Later is a WooCommerce wishlist plugin. Customers click a “Save for Later” button on a product, and find it again on their wishlist page, whether they are logged in or not.

A WooCommerce wishlist gives shoppers a reason to come back: the products they saved are waiting for them. Save Later is lightweight, built with performance and privacy in mind, and works with simple and variable products.

Free WooCommerce wishlist features

Save for later

  • Save for Later button on product and shop pages. On shop pages: before or after Add to Cart, or on the product image. On product pages: before or after Add to Cart, after the gallery or after the summary. Or anywhere with a shortcode
  • Simple and variable products – Save a specific variation (a chosen color or size), not only the parent product
  • Your icon – Choose among the built-in icons or upload your own, with a different icon once the product is saved
  • Icon or text link – Button display mode, tooltip on hover, and every label and notice can be edited
  • Real-time updates – The wishlist and its count update with AJAX, without reloading the page

Guest wishlist

  • Guests and logged-in customers – Visitors can save products without an account
  • Guest-to-user migration – The guest wishlist moves to the customer account automatically on login
  • Automatic cleanup of expired guest sessions, every day. Wishlists of logged-in customers are always kept

Wishlist page

  • Wishlist page created on activation
  • Grid, list or compact layout, with the number of columns and of products per page
  • Choose what the wishlist shows – Image, price, variation, stock status, date added, add to cart and remove buttons
  • Add All to Cart and Remove buttons on the wishlist page
  • Cart options – Remove a product from the wishlist once it is added to the cart, and redirect to the cart after add to cart
  • Save for later from the cart – A “Save for later” link under each product of the cart page, classic cart or Cart block, moves it to the wishlist in one click
  • WooCommerce My Account integration
  • Social sharing – Facebook, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp and Email
  • Shortcodes – [codefaeries_save_later_wishlist] (full wishlist), [codefaeries_save_later_button] (button for a product), [codefaeries_save_later_count] (count badge)
  • Wishlist Count widget with a heart icon, updated live

Set up your wishlist

  • Your colors or your theme’s – Colors for the button, the cart button, the wishlist page and the wishlist table, or your theme’s default style
  • Draft mode – Configure the wishlist before you show it to customers
  • Works with caching plugins – The count is loaded dynamically, so it works with full-page caching
  • Guest settings – Cookie lifetime, cleanup delay and cleanup time
  • Clean uninstall – Optionally delete all plugin data on uninstall
  • Translation-ready, with RTL support. WPML and Polylang compatible

CodeFaeries Save Later Pro

  • Price drop email notifications
  • Back-in-stock email alerts
  • Advanced wishlist sharing with privacy controls
  • Analytics dashboard
  • CSV export of wishlist data
  • Floating wishlist icon with item count badge
  • Popularity counter showing how many shoppers saved a product
  • Customizable email templates via WooCommerce settings
  • Email preferences page in WooCommerce My Account, and one-click unsubscribe from notification emails

More about CodeFaeries Save Later Pro

Do you like Save Later?

A review on wordpress.org helps other store owners find it: leave a review. Thank you.

External services

This plugin includes optional social share buttons on the wishlist (Facebook, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp). They are a convenience feature and are not required to use the plugin.

The plugin itself does not contact these services from your server and does not send them any data on its own. When — and only when — a visitor clicks one of the share buttons, their own browser opens that network’s standard share dialog in a new tab. The information passed is limited to the public URL of the shared wishlist and its title, included in the share link.

Each service is operated by a third party under its own terms and privacy policy:

  • Facebook — opens facebook.com/sharer to share the wishlist link. Terms of service: https://www.facebook.com/terms.php — Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
  • X (Twitter) — opens twitter.com/intent/tweet with the wishlist link and title. Terms of service: https://twitter.com/en/tos — Privacy policy: https://twitter.com/en/privacy
  • Pinterest — opens pinterest.com/pin/create with the wishlist link and title. Terms of service: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/terms-of-service — Privacy policy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy
  • WhatsApp — opens api.whatsapp.com/send with the wishlist link and title. Terms of service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service — Privacy policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

The Email share option uses the visitor’s own email client through a mailto: link and is not a third-party service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/codefaeries-save-later/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. A wishlist page is automatically created on activation. You can also configure settings under the Save Later menu in WordPress admin.
  4. Optionally customize the wishlist shortcode [codefaeries_save_later_wishlist] on your page
sections.faq:
Is CodeFaeries Save Later free?

Yes. The features listed under “Free WooCommerce wishlist features” are free. CodeFaeries Save Later Pro adds price drop and back-in-stock emails, analytics, CSV export and more.

Does the wishlist work for guest users?

Yes. Guest wishlists are stored using browser sessions via cookies. No account is needed to save a product.

What happens to a guest wishlist when the visitor logs in?

It is migrated automatically to the customer account on login.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. When a customer chooses a variation, for example a color and a size, that specific variation is saved, not the parent product.

Where does the Save for Later button appear?

On product and shop pages. On shop pages, before or after the Add to Cart button, or on the product image. On product pages, before or after the Add to Cart button, after the product gallery or after the product summary. You can also place the button yourself with the [codefaeries_save_later_button] shortcode.

Can I change the icon and the colors of the button?

Yes. Choose among the built-in icons or upload your own, with a separate icon for products already saved. Show the button as an icon or as a text link. Keep your theme’s style, or set your own colors for the button, the cart button, the wishlist page and the wishlist table.

Where is the wishlist page?

A wishlist page is created automatically on activation. You can choose another page in the Save Later settings, or place the [codefaeries_save_later_wishlist] shortcode on any page. The wishlist is also integrated in the WooCommerce My Account area.

Can I choose what the wishlist shows?

Yes. Choose a grid, list or compact layout, and show or hide the product image, price, variation, stock status, date added, and the Add to Cart and Remove buttons.

Can customers add the whole wishlist to the cart?

Yes. The wishlist page has an Add All to Cart button.

Can I remove a product from the wishlist once it is in the cart?

Yes. Enable “Remove After Adding to Cart” under Save Later > General > Cart Integration. The product leaves the wishlist when it is added to the cart, from any page. You can also redirect customers to the cart after they add a simple product to the cart from the wishlist.

Can customers save a product for later from the cart?

Yes. Enable “Save for Later in Cart” under Save Later > General > Cart Integration. A “Save for later” link then shows under each product on the cart page, whether it uses the classic [woocommerce_cart] shortcode or the Cart block. One click removes the product from the cart and adds it, with its variation, to the wishlist. The quantity is not kept: the wishlist stores each product once.

Can customers share their wishlist?

Yes, on Facebook, X, Pinterest and WhatsApp, or by email. The plugin does not contact these services from your server: the share dialog opens only when the visitor clicks a share button.

Can I show the number of saved products in my header or menu?

Yes, with the [codefaeries_save_later_count] shortcode or the Wishlist Count widget. You can use several count shortcodes on the same page: all instances update simultaneously when the wishlist changes.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The count is loaded dynamically via AJAX, so it works with full-page caching.

Can I configure the wishlist before my customers see it?

Yes. Draft mode lets you configure everything before launch.

How long are guest wishlists kept?

Expired guest sessions are cleaned up automatically every day. You choose how long guest sessions are kept. Wishlists of logged-in customers are always preserved.

Is it translated? Does it work with WPML or Polylang?

The plugin is translation-ready, supports right-to-left languages, and is compatible with WPML and Polylang.

Can customers be notified of a price drop or when a product is back in stock?

With CodeFaeries Save Later Pro: price drop email notifications and back-in-stock email alerts.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 – 2026-11-20

  • New: “Save for later” link on the cart page, classic cart and Cart block. One click moves a product from the cart to the wishlist. Enable it under Save Later > General > Cart Integration.
  • Fixed: with CodeFaeries Save Later Pro active, the request limits that protect the wishlist actions now apply.

1.0.12 – 2026-11-20

  • Improved: the plugin description, FAQ and screenshots on WordPress.org now cover the cart options, the wishlist columns and layouts, the button icon and the color settings.
  • Improved: the plugin is now listed as “CodeFaeries Save Later – Wishlist and Save for Later for WooCommerce”.
  • Fixed: on the wishlist page, the Share menu now opens under the Share button instead of at the edge of the page.
  • Changed: the floating wishlist icon has been part of CodeFaeries Save Later Pro since 1.0.5.
  • Compatibility: PHP 7.4 or later is required again since 1.0.5.

1.0.9 – 2026-10-08

  • Fixed: on the wishlist page grid, product images now fill their card instead of staying small beside an empty band.
  • Fixed: the “Save for Later” tooltip of the heart button now appears on hover with themes that hid it, such as Storefront.

1.0.7 – 2026-10-05

  • Fixed: in the side preview of the button settings, the “Live Preview” label and its “Theme Default” badge no longer break across two lines.
  • Fixed: the help tab no longer links to a documentation site that does not exist yet.
  • Improved: the bundled admin toolkit is updated to its latest release.
  • Compatibility: tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.0.5 – 2026-07-03

  • Fixed: saving a specific variation of a variable product (e.g. a chosen Color/Size) now records that variation instead of the parent product.
  • Fixed: the Remove and Add All to Cart buttons on the wishlist page now respond again.
  • Fixed: saving one settings tab no longer resets values configured on other tabs, such as the selected wishlist page.

1.0.4 – 2026-06-19

  • New: added an “External services” disclosure describing the social networks used by the share buttons.
  • Improved: the Custom CSS option has moved to CodeFaeries Save Later Pro.
  • Fixed: invalid or private shared-wishlist links now return your theme’s standard 404 page.
  • Compatibility: refinements for WordPress.org Plugin Directory guidelines.

1.0.3 – 2026-05-11

  • Compatibility: minimum PHP requirement lowered to 7.3 — the plugin now runs on a wider range of hosts.
  • Code quality: passes WordPress Plugin Check cleanly.
  • Internal: release packaging refreshed.

1.0.1 – 2026-05-04

  • Fixed: stability fixes at plugin startup — internal services now initialize reliably alongside the shared toolkit.
  • Improved: release packaging tightened.
  • Improved: database migration adds a unique index to prevent duplicate wishlist entries.

1.0.0 – 2026-03-23

First public release. CodeFaeries Save Later is a guest-friendly WooCommerce wishlist with full variable-product support.

  • Save simple and variable products — specific Color/Size combinations are tracked as distinct entries, with graceful fallback when a variation is removed.
  • Works for both guests and logged-in users; guest wishlists migrate automatically on login.
  • “Save for Later” button on product and shop pages, with 13 placement positions (overlay, before/after cart, after price, etc.) and theme-overridable template.
  • Shortcodes: [codefaeries_save_later_wishlist] (full wishlist), [codefaeries_save_later_button] (per product), [codefaeries_save_later_count] (count badge).
  • “Wishlist Count” widget with heart icon, live-updated across the page.
  • Social sharing buttons (Facebook, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Email) and unique-token share links.
  • Floating wishlist icon overlay on product images.
  • Settings under the Save Later admin menu: button, display, guest, cleanup, shortcode, advanced.
  • Automatic daily cleanup of expired guest sessions (logged-in wishlists are always preserved).
  • Translation-ready (POT included) with RTL stylesheet; WPML and Polylang compatible.
  • Security-hardened: nonces, prepared statements, sanitization, escaping.
